# Open Data Contract Standard fixtures

Copied unchanged from [bitol-io/open-data-contract-standard](https://github.com/bitol-io/open-data-contract-standard)
at tag `v3.2.0` (commit `f0bdad95346905d500be5ef4b2c2d9b1d95223b7`). Apache License 2.0,
Copyright The Bitol Contributors.

- `odcs-json-schema-v3.1.0.json`: official JSON Schema for ODCS v3.1.0 (`schema/odcs-json-schema-v3.1.0.json`).
  Exported documents are validated against it.
- `odcs-json-schema-v3.2.0.json`: official JSON Schema for ODCS v3.2.0.
- `examples/*.odcs.yaml`: official examples from `docs/examples/` (`schema/` and `quality/`), used as import inputs.
